summary: A fork of the Golana synth firmware that extends its sequencer to 64 steps, adds a song mode across program slots and sends notes over USB MIDI. Beta.
features: Up to 64 steps per program, 32 programs of sound plus pattern
Song mode plays a range of programs once or on repeat
USB MIDI out of played and sequenced notes
Keeps Golana's two-oscillator synth, five filters, LFOs and arpeggiator
One note per step; sounds and patterns are not separate
Extra steps stored in a separate flash area; back up before switching
